failure_codes.trigger: a required leg has no closed bars / adapter returned none / symbol resolution failed
no bar open-time is present in all three legs (timestamp intersection empty)
failure_codes.action: NO strategy decision; wait for legs to catch up

failure_codes.trigger: a bar in the snapshot is not closed (is_closed=false)
failure_codes.action: NO strategy decision; forming bars never enter

failure_codes.trigger: selected common closed bar older than max_signal_bar_age_s, or >max_signal_bar_lag_bars behind a leg's newest closed bar
failure_codes.action: NO strategy decision; invalidate stale common intersection

failure_codes.trigger: NaN/inf, nonpositive price, high<low, open/close outside [low,high]
the three legs do not share the same bar open time
per-leg duplicate bar open times in the fetched window
dedup: the same synchronized closed bar was already processed

execution_codes.action: NO basket translation (not a coherent simultaneous market state)

execution_codes.trigger: bid<=0, ask<=0, ask<bid, missing tick time
resolution failed or symbol info unavailable
tick timestamp older than previous by > tolerance

skew_threshold_semantics: strictly greater than threshold fails; exactly equal passes (tested: 1000ms valid, 1000ms+1us invalid)
